description: Events, clubs, and campus pages: Event listing with recommendations, event detail with RSVP, event chat, club listing, club detail, and recommendation scoring with explanations.
steps: Create src/app/(main)/events/page.tsx - Events page with two sections: 'Recommended For You' (scored and explained) and 'All Events' (chronological). Each event card shows: name, date/time, location, club/org host, attendee count, 'Why recommended' snippet, RSVP button. Filter by upcoming/past. Empty state.
Create src/components/events/event-card.tsx - Event card with name, date, location, host badge, attendee count, recommendation reason badge, RSVP status indicator, and RSVP action button.
Create src/components/events/recommendation-reason.tsx - Small component showing why an event was recommended (interest match, major relevance, friends attending, etc.).

Create src/app/(main)/events/[id]/page.tsx - Event detail page: event name, full description, date/time/location, host club link, attendee list (showing matches/pod members who are going), recommendation explanation using generateEventRecommendationReason, RSVP buttons (Interested/Going/Not Going), 'Join Event Chat' button (available if RSVP is Going), event scoring breakdown (interest_tag_match 30, major_relevance 20, career_goal_relevance 20, matches_attending 20, availability_fit 10).
Create src/components/events/rsvp-buttons.tsx - Three-state RSVP buttons: Interested (yellow), Going (green), Not Going (gray). Only one active at a time.
Create src/components/events/attendee-list.tsx - List of attendees with badges for 'Your Match' or 'Pod Member' if applicable.
Create src/app/(main)/clubs/page.tsx - Clubs listing page with all 10 clubs. Each card shows: name, description, member count, category tag, events count. Search/filter by category.
Create src/components/clubs/club-card.tsx - Club card with name, short description, member count, and category badge.
Create src/app/(main)/clubs/[id]/page.tsx - Club detail page: name, full description, member list, upcoming events by this club, related clubs, Join/Leave button.
Wire up event recommendations: use recommendEvents from lib/matching/events.ts to score events for current user. Show top recommendations with explanations.
Wire up RSVP actions: update rsvp status in data layer. Going status grants access to event chat conversation.
Show matches/pod members attending: for each event, check if any of the user's matches or pod members have RSVP'd Going and display them.
Handle edge cases: past events (show as past, disable RSVP), no events state, no clubs state, event at capacity (if applicable).
acceptance_criteria: Events page shows recommended events with explanations and all events chronologically
Event detail shows full info, attendees, recommendation reason, and RSVP buttons
RSVP buttons cycle through Interested/Going/Not Going states
Going RSVP grants access to event chat
Clubs page lists all 10 clubs with descriptions
Club detail shows events hosted by that club
Matches/pod members attending are highlighted on event pages
Past events are visually distinguished and have disabled RSVP
